comment.text: CR1 R1842 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1. Source observations include Bladder urothelial carcinoma; Colorectal carcinoma; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cscc; Clear cell renal cell carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma. Additional source tumor types are retained in the structured record. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position. This site is present only in the historical V1 material in this collection.

applicability_notes: Confirm the exact allele and reference transcript: source protein numbering is not a validated clinical HGVS assertion.
Tumor counts describe source cohorts and may overlap between releases and sheets; they must not be added together.
An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.
FDA references are separate gene-level evidence until the exact biomarker, tumor, setting, and current label have been checked.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting CR1 residue R1842 have been observed in cutaneous melanoma, colorectal carcinoma, and endometrial carcinoma.

report_comment.text: The CR1 R1842C alteration has been observed in cutaneous melanoma and endometrial carcinoma.
